card.summary: MX tactile switch, PCB mount (5 pin)

decision.reason: A 3x3 macropad grid of 9 keys needs uniform standard 1u keycaps. The DSA 1u keycap (C5) fits that. The homing variant (C4) has a marker meant for just one or two keys, and the larger sizes would not fit a uniform grid.

filters.label: Footprint in the KiCad board library

card.summary: nRF52840 Pro Micro footprint controller with BLE and LiPo charging
Footprint for Seeduino Xiao nRF52840 controllers, through hole and castellated pads

decision.reason: Both are nRF52840 MCUs with native USB, so either can serve as the controller for a USB macropad. The nice!nano v2 has the Pro Micro footprint and enough exposed GPIO for a key matrix, and it is the standard controller in macropad and keybo
